notes: The published title is a drug reference (crack dealer), so this page is titled Chris Cutchins DS; the post's title is kept below as published.
The post has no starting section; the strategy says the standard start is the Casino with Any Methods Necessary (a starting interrupt). Both are part of the 60 as listed.

The post's character list repeats six Bespin/Cloud City location lines run onto 'Aqualish x 2' (a paste error); the repeats are dropped and Aqualish is counted twice, giving 60. The section headers say Characters (19) and Interrupts (12), but the cards listed are 17 and 13.

Posted 'Battle Order/Secret Plans' is printed as written: no such combo card exists (Battle Order and Secret Plans are separate Effects, and the Reflections III combo is Imperial Arrest Order & Secret Plans), so the card cannot be told for sure. The strategy mentions Secret Plans only.

Posted 'Oppressive Enforcement' (listed under Effects) dested the Special Edition Effect, not the Reflections III Defensive Shield; 'Lando Calrissian' dested Lando Calrissian (Dark); Bespin, Bespin Cloud City, Cloud City Casino, Cloud City Downtown Plaza and Cloud City Sabacc dested the Dark cards; 'TDIGWATT/PIDAIAF' dested the objective This Deal Is Getting Worse All The Time.
Posted 'Mara Jade' dested Mara Jade, The Emperor's Hand; 'Tempest I' Tempest 1; 'OS-72-2 in Obsisian 2' OS-72-2 In Obsidian 2.
